g.text: Explain the advice with the AI assistant (ASUC-02)
Ask a question about a laptop
Build evidence payload and hash it
Input guardrail: size and scope; product text is data, not instructions
Cache lookup (intent, product, evidence hash, mode class)
Value score V and cost estimate; route TEMPLATE | SMALL | LARGE (no agent)
Render answer from template and evidence
Output guardrail: schema, numbers grounded, label equals rule result
Template answer; flag for human review
Trace log (route, model, tokens, latency, energy, mode)
Show explanation next to the evidence
